summary: Targeted retest of iteration_69 fix (AuthContext hydrateUser after login/OTP). Sub-admin uxcheck_sub@corpa.com logs in via email/password, is redirected to /sub-admin/dashboard, and IMMEDIATELY (no reload) sees correct nav (Home, Sales, Feedback, Menu Requests), Assigned scope line '1 client(s)' via data-testid=sub-admin-scope, and 3 tool cards (Sales Reports, Feedback Inbox, Menu Requests). data-testid=sub-admin-no-access is NOT present. All three permitted nav links (Sales -> /reports/sales, Feedback -> /admin/feedback, Menu Requests -> /admin/menu-requests, Home) load without any empty-permission state. Master regression: admin@cravitoo.com/admin123 lands on /master/dashboard with full nav (Dashboard, Cities, Sites, Vendors, Clients, Customer Types, Feedback, Reservations, Billing, Sales, Onboarding, Menu Requests, Domains, Announce, Admins, Reset). OTP UI regression: 'Login with Email Code' button renders and clicking it shows the Send Code form with no JS errors. Only console errors observed were expected 401s from /auth/me polls on the pre-login page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_69 bug (login not hydrating sub_admin permissions/scope) is fully fixed. hydrateUser() in AuthContext successfully calls /auth/me after both password and OTP login and populates user.permissions + user.scope, so nav + /sub-admin/dashboard render correctly on first render — no manual reload required. Master admin login and OTP UI still work.
rca of the issue: Prior bug: login/OTP responses did not include sub_admin permissions/scope, so the frontend user object was incomplete until a manual reload triggered checkAuth->/auth/me. Fix: AuthContext.login() and loginWithOtp() now invoke hydrateUser() which fetches /api/auth/me and setUser() with the complete payload (falls back to login response on failure). Verified: fresh login populates user immediately; downstream Navbar and Sub-admin Dashboard render permissions and scope correctly.
